redFlags.label: Face recognition
redFlags.detail: The Stutsman County Narcotics Task Force can run face recognition requests through the North Dakota Bureau of Criminal Investigation's face recognition system. The agency submitted two requests through the Bureau of Criminal Investigation's face recognition system between March 2023 to October 2024.
